create_app: create a Starlette app for the HuggingFace datasets server with configured endpoints and middleware
create_app_with_config: create a Starlette app with explicit AppConfig and EndpointConfig instances
start: start the HuggingFace datasets server API using uvicorn with environment-configured host and port
build_app_with_jwt: build a Starlette app with JWT public keys for authenticated HuggingFace API endpoints
test_app_resources: test the app initializes MongoDB cache and queue resources before starting
